title: BHCG Level in Day 4,7, in Comparison to Day 10 as an Indicator for Treatment Success
brief_summary: The investigators want to compeer BHCG levels after Methotrexate ( MTX). treatment for Ectopic pregnancy in days 4 and 7 after MTX. to day 10 . The hypothesis is that "BHCG" level in day 10 is the best indicator for treatment success , superior to day 4 and 7 . According to the investigators impression BHCG level rises in days 4 and 7 due to destruction of the trophoblast tissue , and only day 10 is an indicator for treatment success
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients with ectopic pregnancy
* healthy
* hemodynamic stable
* first ectopic

Exclusion Criteria:

* hemodynamic non-stable
* abnormal liver or kidney function
* allergy reaction to MTX
